Axel Society is a digital marketplace that empowers entrepreneurs and small to medium business owners with high-quality digital products. Our mission is to provide valuable resources that help individuals start, grow, and scale their businesses efficiently.

Product Description:

We offer a range of premium digital products, including business templates, marketing resources, financial planning tools, and strategy guides. Our products are designed to save time, improve efficiency, and provide structured guidance for entrepreneurs navigating their business journey.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • High-quality, professionally crafted digital products tailored for entrepreneurs.
  • Instant access and easy-to-use resources.
  • No recurring fees—one-time purchase for lifetime access.
  • Created based on real business needs and industry insights.

Payment Terms:

We offer monthly payouts for affiliates, depending on their preference. Payments are made through PayPal or bank transfer, ensuring a smooth and reliable commission process.

Other Information:

  • Axel Society does sell PLR (Private Label Rights) products; all products are uniquely designed for real business applications.
  • We continuously expand our product offerings based on industry trends and customer feedback.
  • Dedicated customer support to assist with product usage and inquiries.

Axel Society Affiliate Program Terms of Service

These Terms of Service (the "Agreement") govern your participation in the Axel Society Affiliate Program (the "Program") and establish the terms and conditions of the Program. By participating in the Program, you agree to abide by these terms.

Guidelines

1. Self-referrals are not allowed

You are not permitted to purchase products from Axel Society using your own affiliate link. If we detect any self-referrals, your account will be permanently banned, and any commission earned will be forfeited.

2. Abuse or attempts to mislead

We do not tolerate attempts to manipulate, abuse, or mislead our affiliate system. Any attempt to defraud us or potential customers will result in an immediate ban from the Program. Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to:

  • Posting false discounts on coupon-sharing websites.
  • Using misleading marketing tactics.
  • Engaging in any fraudulent or deceptive activity.

3. No paid ads that compete with Axel Society’s marketing

Affiliates are not allowed to run:

  • Search engine ads (especially on branded terms or domain names).
  • Facebook or other social media ads that compete with our marketing.
  • Any paid advertisements that may cause confusion for customers.

If we detect any such activity, your affiliate account may be terminated.

4. No impersonation of Axel Society

You may not represent yourself as an employee, agent, or official representative of Axel Society. Affiliates must make it clear that they are independent partners promoting our products.

5. Changes to the Terms of Service

Axel Society reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Any updates will be posted on our website, and it is your responsibility to review and comply with the updated terms.

Payouts

1. Definitions

  • Affiliate: An individual or entity approved to participate in the Axel Society Affiliate Program and promote our products.
  • Commission: The percentage earned on each successful referral. Axel Society offers a flat 20% commission on all referred sales.
  • Qualified Referral: A referral that results in a successful sale of Axel Society digital products and meets the conditions outlined in the Affiliate Program Guidelines.
  • Payment Period: Commissions are paid on a weekly or monthly basis, depending on the affiliate's preference.
  • Cookie Duration: The tracking period for affiliate referrals is 60 days, meaning sales made within 60 days of a user clicking your link will be attributed to you.
  • Payment Methods: Payments are processed via PayPal or bank transfer. Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment details.
  • Termination: Axel Society reserves the right to remove an affiliate from the program if they violate these terms.

2. Commission Payout

Affiliates will receive their commissions on monthly basis, based on their selected payment preference.

3. Minimum Payout Threshold

There is no minimum payout threshold. Commissions will be paid regardless of the amount earned.

4. Termination

Axel Society reserves the right to terminate an affiliate’s participation in the program if they violate these terms.

5. Affiliate Dashboard

Affiliates will have access to a dashboard where they can track their sales, commissions, and performance.

6. Tax and Legal Responsibilities

Affiliates are solely responsible for any tax obligations related to their commissions. Axel Society does not provide tax or legal advice.

7. Updates to Terms

Axel Society may update these terms at any time without prior notice. Affiliates are responsible for reviewing any changes to remain compliant.

By participating in the Axel Society Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms.

For any questions or concerns, please contact us at office@axelsociety.com.
